They want us to swallow the lie that this is just a routine legal slip-up or accidental incompetence, but that is merely the cover story. Behind the scenes, the hidden elites and institutions coordinated a systemic operation. 

Look at what the court documents actually expose: lawyers for ICE provided false information to justify arresting and detaining thousands of people who had attended immigration courts. Their excuse was an agency memo from May of last year to justify the arrests, yet federal prosecutors now admit that this very memo gave no authorization for the arrests at all. 

This was never about mistakes. It was a calculated, systemic operation to target people seeking to gain legal status as they leave immigration courts, perfectly revealing how the machinery of the state operates under a false narrative while executing its true, concealed agenda.
